question: As of November 2022, who among the following is the Governor of Andhra Pradesh, India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Biswabhushan Harichandan.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Biswabhushan Harichandan:-**

 
 
• **He served as a cabinet minister in the BJD-BJP led coalition government in Odisha from 2004 to 2009. **
 
• He was the Minister of Law, Revenue and Fisheries. 
 
• During his tenure as minister, Harichandan is credited with reforming the state's land laws and making the revenue administration more efficient. He also played a key role in developing the state's fisheries sector.
 
• **In 2019, Harichandan was appointed the 23rd Governor of Andhra Pradesh. He served in that position till early 2023. He was then appointed the 8th and current Governor of Chhattisgarh.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Hemant Soren:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian politician who is the current Chief Minister of Jharkhand. **
 
• He is the working president of the Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM), a regional political party in Jharkhand.
 
 
 
• **Bhagat Singh Koshyari:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian politician who served as the 22nd governor of Maharashtra from 2019 to 2023. **
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
 
 
• **Anusuiya Uikey:-**
 
 
• **She is an Indian politician who is currently serving as the Governor of Manipur. **
 
• She is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
